contents.entry: The entry set: every table of 04-UNLANDED.md, one disposition each
The seven steps and their triggers
Mechanism: a generated plan, a dry run on the card, an apply per step
How it starts without an agent typing
Every wait, its timeout and its fallback
What this volume needs from the shared volumes

pointers.sibling: Input and output record schema of this node
Cleanup registry and runs, which executes the supersede and close dispositions
Cut-over records, which handles PR 35, the fourteen tickets and the design branch
pointers.shared: Everything on main, nothing left lying around (owner, 2026-10-14)
Where this node goes live in the one cut-over order of the book

purpose.is: Turns every row of rebuild/investigation/04-UNLANDED.md into one disposition record (land, supersede, close, keep) and executes the supersede and close rows in the section 12 order, dry run first, as the first slice after GOFACTORY (D25 A).
Land rows become ticket requests to N-03 (re-entry), one per LAND row, so the landing goes through the normal path (cut, validate, worker, gate, review, merge) and never by hand.
purpose.is-not: It never deletes anything itself; N-45 deletes from disposition records, after the same dry-run contract. It never reads a verdict from an agent; the verdict column is the source, and the D-rulings resolve the DECIDE rows.
purpose.why: Owner, 2026-10-14T02:49Z: everything needs to get on main too, dont leave that shit laying around; then 02:52Z nothing starts again till GOFACTORY. D25 A: the later, broader order wins; the owner sees exactly what will be deleted before saying go.

input.record: The GOFACTORY ruling record: the owner word GOFACTORY matched by N-29 as the whole trimmed message from an owner principal on the owner page or the owner CLI (shared/authority.xml#owner-words). A chat relay id, a default, an import or a seat-produced text is never GOFACTORY, and N-49 applies nothing on such a ruling. Before it arrives, the plan verb may run on the daily tick and its dry-run listing is attached to the GOFACTORY card (N-28), which carries no default and no deadline.
The daily tick: re-plans while no GOFACTORY ruling exists, so the dry run on the card is never older than a day.
For LAND rows: the merge of the land ticket closes the row's disposition (state done).

output.record: One per entry, state planned: entry id, section, the row's key (branch name, worktree path, issue number, file path), verdict from the table, action resolved (land, supersede, close, keep, re-verdict), step number, what will be done, the sha or size it has now.
State done: what was done, the N-45 cleanup.run id or the land ticket's merge id, the issue closing comment id.

Three attempts failed on the entry; the last error; owner acts when the entry is in another repository the service has no write to (section 10 rows) or a KEEP row whose trigger never arrives by the timeout.
One per LAND row, to N-03: title from the row, files declared, acceptance commands from the row's reason column where they exist, lane rebuild, scope build-mode.

entries.section: PR 35: DECIDE D14 then CLOSE; D14 is ruled (C42); the close is N-50's record; this node's entry points at it and completes when N-50 reports.

entries.section: Each row resolves by the ruled decision: merge.sh and verify-main.sh LAND as N-09 and N-10 actions (their tickets are cut from those nodes, not from here); d93a, 7f99, 3dae, 48f2, 612d SUPERSEDE by D01 B and D02 B (cancel records through N-03 with the reason); 3217, aff2, 3eac LAND with the trigger changed to the tick (D06 C), as ticket requests naming N-08, N-10 and N-07; Jenkins JCasC LAND under N-20; the hook units DECIDE D06 ruled C, SUPERSEDE (accelerators later); coq-supervisor template SUPERSEDE by D08 B units; board.sh wiring LAND under N-28; a1c6 capacity SUPERSEDE by N-07 caps; 8e0c LAND under N-27 and N-42 (the halt flag keeps stable alive); d1cd, 9189, 5dce CLOSE (acceptance already passes on main); be64 LAND (decision nodes, a docs ticket).

Rows in other repositories the service has no write access to are owner-acts 423 after the attempts, never a silent skip.

CLOSE now 11 with the named commit in the closing comment; CLOSE on a ruling 8 (every named decision is now ruled, so these close with the ruling id in the comment); FOLD 12: the disposition stays open and closes by Closes #N from the merge of the named build item (N-09 writes Closes #N from the ticket's issue field); KEEP-OPEN 2 (47 product, 52 owner infrastructure) labelled.
entries.rule: The entry set is generated from the tables, keyed by section and row key; a row the parser cannot key fails the plan (400) and is a fix ticket for the parser, never a skipped row. The count of entries is in every disposition record so the owner can see 100 percent coverage on the card.

order.step: Back up first: the page.html and theme.css diffs, the 539a residue diff and the three backlog/now files into $COQ_STATE/backup/unlanded/<date>/ (the HANDOFF patch already holds the page edits; the step verifies it and copies it too).

step.trigger: step 1 done and the hold flag present

order.step: Records: the A4 ticket request (LAND) is cut; this step completes when its merge record arrives; its reconcile of the 5,812 copies and the removal of tracked events/ and changelog/ files are inside that ticket. If the hold flag is absent, the step waits for it up to 24 hours then posts one card (the owner's USERHALT is the ticket's own precondition).
Checkout: discard the 539a residue, delete backlog/now, fast-forward the owner checkout (git -C <owner checkout> merge --ff-only origin/main, refused if dirty beyond the known three files).
Owner page: the page-edits ticket request (LAND, one small ticket, formatter churn removed); completes on its merge and N-48's stable promotion 201.
Git clutter: disposition records for sections 3 to 6 to N-45 (tag-then-delete, delete, archive, worktree remove, remote remove, slot return), then delete_branch_on_merge true.
Issues: the 11 CLOSE-now and the 8 CLOSE-on-ruling with comments; FOLD rows stay open with their build item named; KEEP-OPEN labelled.
Off-repo runtime and dark code: sections 8, 9 and 10 dispositions; LAND rows as ticket requests; SUPERSEDE and CLOSE rows to N-45; DECIDE rows as bundled cards whose only default is keep (wait w6).
order.s: Each step is a disposition group; a step starts on the previous step's success record; a step with a 423 entry does not block the next step unless the next step's rows depend on it (only step 2 to 3 and 3 to 4 depend).

mechanism.where: rebuild/bin/unlanded.sh in the repository (BI09), with verbs plan (parse the tables at a sha into the entry set JSON and the dry-run listing), apply --step N --plan <hash> (emit disposition and ticket.request records for that step), and status; run by the service as an Executor.Run verb unlanded; deletions go through N-45 by disposition record; GitHub writes (issue comments, PR close, repository settings) go through the service's forge auth with the same three-attempt rule.
mechanism.step: plan: parse 04-UNLANDED.md at the main sha from the mirror; resolve every DECIDE row against the rulings table (C34 to C58 records); write the entry set with resolved actions and the dry-run listing (what would be deleted, what would be tagged, which issues would close with which comment, which tickets would be requested); the listing hash is the plan hash; the service writes disposition 100 per entry and attaches the listing to the GOFACTORY card through N-28.
On the GOFACTORY ruling: re-plan; if the hash differs from the one on the card, the apply refuses (409) and the new listing goes on a fresh card: the owner always sees what runs.

apply per step in order: emit records; wait for completion records (N-45 cleanup.run 200, merge records for ticket requests, forge responses) with the timeouts below; write disposition 200 or 423 per entry.

diagram.mermaid: flowchart TD T[daily tick] --> P[plan: entry set + dry-run listing] P --> C[N-28: listing on the GOFACTORY card] G[GOFACTORY ruling] --> R{replan hash == card hash?} R -- no --> C2[fresh card with the new listing] R -- yes --> S1[step 1 backups] S1 --> S2[step 2 A4 ticket, needs hold flag] S2 --> S3[step 3 checkout] S3 --> S4[step 4 page edits ticket + stable promotion] S4 --> S5[step 5 git clutter via N-45] S5 --> S6[step 6 issues] S6 --> S7[step 7 off-repo and dark code]

start.s: The daily tick plans; the GOFACTORY ruling record applies; LAND rows enter N-03 as ticket requests and come back as merge records; no agent runs a cleanup command and no agent decides a row.

wait.fallback: nothing runs; the card carries the latest listing; D25 A

one owner card asking for USERHALT, with no default (an owner word is never defaulted); independently, after another 24 h the system runs the ticket's reconcile-only half (copy ids missing from the state root, delete nothing), which needs no owner word, so the record set is safe while the deletion waits
the disposition stays planned with reason ticket-late and N-11's dead path for the ticket posts the card; the step does not block later steps except 2 to 3 and 3 to 4

wait.what: N-45 cleanup.run for a step's dispositions
wait.fallback: 423 rows from N-45 are copied into the dispositions; the step completes with partial, the next step starts, the rows retry on N-45's next trigger
ladder 10, 30, 90 s; then 423 on the entry

the row resolves to keep: N-49 writes disposition 200 with action keep and reason default-keep; nothing is deleted, archived or closed, no ruling is written and no owner-only effect follows. A default never produces an owner word, a break glass or a destructive action (shared/authority.xml#owner-words); a card that offers any owner-only choice carries no default and no deadline, and waits like w1. The owner may answer later and re-verdict the row.

waits.cog-test: The cog that could stall this node is the owner answering 33 issue verdicts and 34 branch verdicts one by one. The table already carries every verdict; the owner sees one listing and says go once; the only cards left are the three bundled DECIDE rows, whose only default is keep.

retries.policy: Per entry; successful entries are never redone (every action is idempotent: a deleted branch is already-gone, a closed issue is already-closed, a tag that exists at the same sha is present).
retries.recover: After three failures the entry is 423 with the last error and the step completes partial; a daily tick re-applies 423 entries whose error class is transient (network, rate limit) for up to 7 days, then stops and the alert stays.
retries.report: Progress is the Stats screen counter (entries done over total) and the rail panel row for R-04; the owner gets a card only for owner-acts 423 rows and for the DECIDE bundles.

many-agents.readers: Landing seats (R-04 of the plan) read their LAND ticket, never this volume's entry set; the entry set is a store table every screen can read.
many-agents.writers: One run at a time under lease unlanded:run; the plan verb is read-only and may run while an apply runs (it only changes the next card).
many-agents.collision: A LAND ticket's worker and the step-5 branch deletion naming the same branch (for example a branch a ticket re-uses): refused upstream, because a ticket request names its files and N-14 claims them; branches are deleted only after the ticket that referenced them is done or when no ticket references them.
N-45's merge trigger and a step-5 disposition deleting the same branch: both idempotent; the second records already-gone.

Two GOFACTORY answers on the same card (a page retry and the owner CLI): N-29 writes one ruling per card (entity ruling:<card> at version 0) and the second answer is refused; a chat relay of the word is never a GOFACTORY answer at all.
The owner editing the checkout during step 3: the fast-forward refuses a dirty tree beyond the known files (409 dirty) and the step retries on the next daily tick; nothing is reset.

status-codes.emits: Planned; system acts (waits for GOFACTORY or executes in order).
Plan hash changed since the card, or a dirty checkout; system acts (fresh card or daily retry).
A table row the parser cannot key; system acts (fix ticket request for the parser).
Failed after 3; system acts (daily transient retry) or owner acts (other repositories).
A LAND row's ticket, to N-03.

may.do: plan at any time; apply after the GOFACTORY ruling; write dispositions and ticket requests; call the forge for comments, closes and settings; fast-forward the owner checkout
GOFACTORY (owner principal, owner page or owner CLI only); answer the bundled DECIDE cards; rule a row kept (a ruling that re-verdicts an entry)

may-not.do: run unlanded.sh apply; delete branches, worktrees or files outside its ticket; close issues

reset or checkout in the owner checkout (fast-forward only); delete a KEEP row; delete the backup tree; act on another repository without that repository's entry naming the write; turn a timed-out card into anything but keep
carry GOFACTORY or any answer that applies a disposition

monitoring.counter: Current step 1 to 7 and its start time.
git branch -r --no-merged origin/main count; the exit proof wants every remaining one named in a KEEP disposition.
monitoring.panel: R-04 row moves only when a disposition 200 lands.

runbook.step: Read the listing on the card; a row the owner wants kept is answered as words on the card and becomes a ruling that re-verdicts the entry; no edit to the table by hand.
Answer the card: do it (the owner's own command, recorded by N-42) or rule it kept.

step.when: the owner checkout is dirty beyond the known files

runbook.step: Commit or stash the owner's own change; the daily retry fast-forwards.
rebuild/bin/unlanded.sh plan and apply --step N by the owner; records are written the same way.
runbook.cleanup: line/bin/cleanup.sh --entry N-49.plan, N-49.log; N-49.backup and N-49.handoff-patch only by the owner.
runbook.cold-start: Dispositions are in the store; status shows the current step; apply resumes at the first entry not done.

dispositions: entry_id, section, key, verdict, action, step, state, attempt, result_ref; leases unlanded:run.
disposition, ticket.request (title, files, acceptance, lane, scope, home node), ruling (GOFACTORY, re-verdict), merge, cleanup.run.
100 planned, 200 done, 409 plan changed or dirty, 400 unkeyable row, 423 failed after 3 (owner acts for other repositories and DECIDE defaults).

Card attachments: a listing file path and a count line on a card; the dedupe window for bundled DECIDE cards; a card whose only default is keep and a deadline (V17 standing policies); owner-only cards (GOFACTORY, USERHALT) with no default and no deadline.
ticket.request as a valid intake with lane rebuild and home node; N-18 validates its acceptance commands on main.
One answer per card; a ruling may re-verdict a disposition entry by id; GOFACTORY only from an owner principal on the owner page or CLI (shared/authority.xml#owner-words).
